subject.why: The hammock is clearly recognizable, complete with the two leaning palm trees, red-and-white stripes, and the coconut resting inside.

category.why: Category 4 requires only a single key element strip at the bottom against a sky gradient, but this shows both sand and an ocean band, along with scattered ground scenery, and is framed at eye level rather than a low, heroic camera angle.

clean.why: There are no UI elements, text, watermarks, borders, or characters.

framing.why: The subject is centrally framed with clear margins around the palm fronds and nothing important cut off.

colour.why: The colors are vibrant, warm, and saturated, separating clearly from the blue sky.

detail.why: The foreground includes extra scenery props such as scattered shells, pebbles, and grass tufts that clutter the setting.

style.why: The rendering matches the references with smooth, chunky shapes, a soft satin sheen, and no outlines or photographic textures.

fix: Remove the ocean layer, pebbles, and shells so there is only a single clean strip of sand beneath the sky gradient, and tilt the camera lower to give the palm hammock a more heroic perspective.
